additional_info.body:
Hello Franck, good afternoon.
The error is due to the Coap polling error. When the charger is free, I can install a hotfix and it should be fixed.
If you see the charger free, please deactivate the outlets so that I can update it or align with the customer for a time between 9am and 6pm CET.
Otherwise I will try to proactively check it myself.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
